scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p server && vite build && tsx scripts/check-bundle.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && playwright test
scripts.bench:render: npm run build && playwright test -c bench/playwright.config.ts --reporter=list
scripts.start: npm run build && APP_URL=${APP_URL:-http://localhost:8787} NODE_ENV=production NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 STATIC_DIR=dist tsx server/src/index.ts
